title: Create a Node Library
description: Create a Node library under `libs/<domain>[/<subdomain>...]/[<group>/]infra`, wrapping `@nx/node:library` with the workspace naming, directory, and tag conventions (ADR 0009). Restricted to `type:infra` — the one backend-only, non-Nest type left after `js-plugin:lib` covers the framework-agnostic set; `api`/`services` are Nest-only and out of scope here.

type.description: The project's `type:` tag and the final directory segment. Restricted to `infra` — the only Node-specific, non-Nest, backend-only type in ADR 0004's closed set.

domain.description: The product domain (and optional `/`-separated subdomains, e.g. `billing/checkout`) this library belongs to. Required — a `libs/` project is never domain-exempt (ADR 0009).

group.description: An optional label distinguishing this library from siblings of the same type within its domain. Omittable — `infra` is typically one-per-domain (ADR 0009).

name.description: Literal project-name override passed straight through to `@nx/node:library`. When given, it replaces the derived name; the directory is still derived from `domain`/`group`/`type`.

linter.description: The tool to use for running lint checks.

unitTestRunner.description: Test runner to use for unit tests. The workspace standardizes on Jest (ADR 0007).

tags.description: Additional freeform tags appended to the generated `scope:backend`/`type:infra`/`domain:` tags, comma-separated.

compiler.description: The compiler used by the build and test targets.

importPath.description: The library name used to import it, like `@cybertecpty/my-lib`. Must be a valid npm name.

rootDir.description: Sets the `rootDir` for TypeScript compilation. When not defined, it uses the project's root property.

enableTypedLinting.description: Whether to enable typed linting. We do not enable this by default for lint performance reasons (ADR 0006).

useProjectJson.description: Use a `project.json` configuration file instead of inlining the Nx configuration in the `package.json` file.

skipTsConfig.description: Do not update `tsconfig.base.json` for development experience.
